replies.author: MidnightBeats
replies.body:
Hello.

First, you denied the recording's legitimacy by stating it was "edited," and then you proceed to apologize for your actions. I would like to point out that lying will not help your appeal, and would also like to say that the video was not edited.

Unfortunately, punishments for hacking may only be appealed after some period of time.
As of now, this appeal is denied. You may appeal again at a later time.

Regards,
MidnightBeats
